name: amfx-unemployment-deficit-scatter
description: amFX reproduction: US Unemployment Rate vs Budget Deficit (% of GDP) scatter, color-coded by decade. Shows the Keynesian countercyclical relationship (high unemployment = larger deficit) breaking down in the 2020s with procyclical MMT-style fiscal policy. Data: FRED UNRATE (monthly unemployment) + MTSDS133FMS (monthly deficit $M) / GDP (quarterly $B) to compute monthly deficit as % of GDP.
source:
# =============================================================================
# amFX REPRODUCTION: US UNEMPLOYMENT vs BUDGET DEFICIT SCATTER (by Decade)
# =============================================================================
# Reproduces the scatter chart from amFX newsletter (02 Aug 2023) by Brent Donnelly.
# X = US Unemployment Rate (UNRATE, monthly)
# Y = Federal Surplus/Deficit as % of GDP (computed monthly)
# Color-coded by decade to show how the orthodox Keynesian countercyclical
# relationship (high unemployment -> larger deficit) breaks down in the 2020s.
#
# Data: FRED UNRATE (monthly), MTSDS133FMS (monthly deficit $M), GDP (quarterly $B)
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# DATA FETCH —  for full FRED history
# =============================================================================

# US Unemployment Rate (monthly, ~1948 onward)
unemp_src = economic_indicators(series_id='UNRATE')()
unemp = ffill(unemp_src.result)

# Monthly Federal Surplus/Deficit (millions $, ~1953 onward)
deficit_m_src = economic_indicators(series_id='MTSDS133FMS')()
deficit_m = ffill(deficit_m_src.result)

# Quarterly GDP (billions $, ~1947 onward) — ffill to monthly
gdp_src = economic_indicators(series_id='GDP')()
gdp = ffill(gdp_src.result)

# Trailing 12-month sum of monthly deficit (smooths out seasonal swings)
deficit_12m = sum(period=12)(deficit_m)

# Deficit as % of GDP: (12m deficit in $M) / (GDP in $B * 1000) * 100
deficit = deficit_12m / (gdp * 1000.0) * 100.0

# =============================================================================
# DECADE CLASSIFICATION
# Extract year from bar index, then create decade-conditional deficit columns.
# Each decade column has the deficit value only when year falls in that decade,
# NaN otherwise. xy_scatter automatically filters NaN points.
# =============================================================================

year = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(index())

# Decade masks using where(condition, value)
deficit_1970s = where(year >= 1970 and year <= 1979, deficit)
deficit_1980s = where(year >= 1980 and year <= 1989, deficit)
deficit_1990s = where(year >= 1990 and year <= 1999, deficit)
deficit_2000s = where(year >= 2000 and year <= 2009, deficit)
deficit_2010s = where(year >= 2010 and year <= 2019, deficit)
deficit_2020s = where(year >= 2020 and year <= 2029, deficit)

# =============================================================================
# SCATTER CHART
# xy_scatter: x = unemployment rate, y_values = decade-split deficit columns
# Each Y series becomes a separate colored scatter series.
# show_trend_line uses first Y series for OLS regression.
# =============================================================================

xy_scatter(
    title='Where Did the Keynesian Playbook Go? US Unemployment vs Deficit by Decade',
    category='Fiscal Policy Regime',
    x_axis_label='US Unemployment Rate (%)',
    y_axis_label='Federal Surplus/Deficit (% of GDP)',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    show_trend_line=True,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='1980s', color=Color.Cyan, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker),
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='1990s', color=Color.Yellow, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker),
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='2000s', color=Color.Gray, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker),
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='2010s', color=Color.Orange, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker),
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='2020s', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Balanced Budget', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=0
)(unemp, deficit_1980s, deficit_1990s, deficit_2000s, deficit_2010s, deficit_2020s)
